title: How much does scuba diving cost in Hurghada in 2026?
body_markdown:
Scuba diving cost in Hurghada in 2026 isn't one number — it splits by certification level, dive count, and season, and the single biggest swing factor is whether you're renting full gear or already own it. The daily dive fee itself is rarely the expensive part; the certification course usually is.


**TL;DR**

- Hurghada diving cost in 2026 splits into four tiers: Discover Scuba, certified single or multi-dive trips, PADI Open Water certification, and liveaboard packages.
- Certification, not the daily dive fee, is usually the largest line item in a Hurghada diving budget.
- Gear rental, boat distance to the reef, and high season (October to April) all push the total up or down.
- Daily Red Sea lists current trip and course options directly on its site rather than a fixed rate card.


## Why this matters

Ask five dive operators in Hurghada for a quote and you'll get five different structures, not five versions of the same number. One quote covers a single boat dive with tank and weights included. Another bundles four dives across two days. A third is a full [beginner scuba diving course](https://dailyredsea.byryze.com/best-scuba-diving-courses-in-hurghada-for-beginners) spread across several days of pool and open-water training.

Comparing those quotes side by side without knowing what's included is exactly why "Hurghada diving cost" searches turn up conflicting numbers online. The fix isn't finding a magic average — it's knowing which product you're actually pricing before you compare anything.

## How much does scuba diving cost in Hurghada?

Hurghada diving cost sits across four distinct products, and each one has its own inclusions. Matching the right tier to your certification status and time in Egypt matters more than chasing the lowest quote.

| Dive type | What's included | Spend tier | Best for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Discover Scuba (no cert required) | Instruction, one supervised dive, full gear | Entry-level | First-timers testing the water |
| Certified single or two-tank dive | Boat transfer, tank, weights, guide | Entry to mid-range | Certified divers on a day trip |
| PADI Open Water course | 3-4 days training, materials, certification card | Mid to premium | Travelers who want a lifetime certification |
| Liveaboard (multi-day) | Cabin, meals, multiple daily dives, crew | Premium | Divers chasing remote reefs and wrecks |


![Diver descending along a Red Sea coral reef wall in Hurghada](https://gwvckixiegkllthleuyt.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/workspace-article-images-public/87b00d29-4f6a-4183-a333-ed90b7b6fe06/body-79937d303fe008f7adeeb1a1ca6a3b01.jpg)

*Reef depth and distance from shore are two of the biggest swing factors in what a dive trip costs.*


### Discover Scuba dives: the entry point for non-certified divers

Discover Scuba is built for travelers with zero diving experience and no certification card. It bundles a short in-water briefing with one supervised dive, using full rental gear, and an instructor stays within arm's reach the entire time.

This is the highest per-dive cost tier because it includes one-on-one instructor time that certified dives skip. **Verdict: buy this if you've never dived and just want to try it once — skip it if you're already certified, since a standard dive trip covers the same reef for less overhead.**

### Certified diver trips: single tanks and multi-dive packages

Once you hold a certification card from PADI, SSI, or an equivalent agency, Hurghada operators drop the instructional overhead and price by tank count instead. A [certified diver dive trip](https://dailyredsea.byryze.com/scuba-diving-for-certified-divers-in-hurghada) typically runs as a single-tank day boat outing or a two-tank package hitting two reef sites in one trip.

The further the site sits from shore, the more the boat time adds to the total — house reefs cost less to reach than offshore wrecks. **Verdict: buy multi-dive packages over single dives if you're diving more than once during your stay; the per-dive rate drops with volume.**

### PADI Open Water certification: the biggest line item

A PADI Open Water course is where Hurghada diving cost jumps hardest, because it bundles 3 to 4 days of classroom time, confined-water practice, and open-water dives into one package, plus course materials and the certification card itself. That timeline is a global PADI standard, not something specific to Egypt.

Once certified, every dive afterward costs less than the course did per session, since you're no longer paying for instructor supervision. **Verdict: worth it if you're staying in Hurghada 4+ days and want a certification that's valid worldwide for life — skip it if you're only in town for a weekend.**

### Liveaboard trips: multi-day cost stacks up differently

Liveaboard trips price by trip length rather than dive count, covering a cabin, meals, crew, and multiple dives per day across several days at sea. They reach remote reefs and wreck sites a day boat can't hit and return from in a single afternoon.

Most operators require at least an Open Water certification before booking a berth, since the itinerary assumes independent diving skills. **Verdict: worth booking if you want access to sites day trips can't reach — wait on this one if you're not yet certified.**

## Why Hurghada diving cost varies

A handful of factors decide where any given quote lands, and they stack on top of each other rather than working in isolation.

- **Certification level** — Discover Scuba, Open Water, and Advanced Open Water sit at different price points because they include different amounts of instructor time.
- **Number of dives and days booked** — multi-dive packages bring the per-dive rate down compared to booking single dives one at a time.
- **Gear rental vs. owning your own** — full rental gear costs more than bringing a mask, fins, and wetsuit from home.
- **Distance to the dive site** — house reefs close to shore cost less to reach than offshore wrecks or remote reef systems.
- **Season** — high season roughly October through April draws more divers and tighter boat availability than the summer off-season.
- **Boat type** — a shared day boat, a private charter, and a liveaboard cabin all carry different overhead.


![Diagram showing six factors that influence Hurghada diving cost](https://gwvckixiegkllthleuyt.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/workspace-article-images-public/87b00d29-4f6a-4183-a333-ed90b7b6fe06/body-29d0bbf22493fa88f0e4ba6ca15b1a4d.jpg)

*Certification level and gear rental move the total more than most divers expect.*




### Is diving cheaper in Hurghada than Sharm El Sheikh or Marsa Alam?

Hurghada, Sharm El Sheikh, and Marsa Alam draw from the same Red Sea dive operator pool, so day-trip and certification pricing tends to track closely across all three cities. The bigger swing factor is which specific dive sites and boat type you book in 2026, not which city you fly into.

### Do dive packages include equipment rental?

Most Hurghada dive packages include tank, weights, and BCD in the base price, but wetsuits, dive computers, and underwater cameras are often rented separately. Confirm what's bundled before booking, since "equipment included" varies by operator and by season.

### How much extra does a Discover Scuba dive cost compared to a certified dive?

A Discover Scuba dive typically costs more than a single certified dive because it includes one-on-one instructor time and a longer pre-dive briefing. Certified divers skip that instructional overhead entirely, and multi-dive packages push the per-dive rate down even further.

## FAQ


**What's the best type of dive for a first-time scuba diver in Hurghada?**

Discover Scuba is the best fit for anyone without a certification card, pairing one dive with an instructor and no prior training required. Certified divers should book a single or multi-tank trip instead, which drops the per-dive rate.

**How long does a PADI Open Water course take in Hurghada?**

A PADI Open Water course in Hurghada usually runs 3 to 4 days, combining classroom sessions, confined-water practice, and open-water dives. That timeline is a global PADI standard, not specific to Egypt.

**Is Hurghada diving cost higher in high season?**

Yes, high season in Hurghada runs roughly October through April, when dive demand peaks alongside cooler, more comfortable air temperatures. Booking in the summer off-season generally means less competition for boat spots.

**Do I need my own gear to dive in Hurghada?**

No, full gear rental is standard at Hurghada dive operators, covering tank, BCD, regulator, and weights. Bringing your own wetsuit or dive computer is optional and mostly a comfort preference.

**What depth can a certified Open Water diver reach in Hurghada?**

A PADI Open Water diver is certified to 18 meters (60 feet), while Advanced Open Water extends that to 30 meters (100 feet). Hurghada reef sites generally accommodate both certification levels without issue.

**Is a liveaboard trip worth it over day boat diving in Hurghada?**

A liveaboard is worth it if you want access to remote reefs and wreck sites a day boat can't reach round-trip in a single afternoon. Day boats work better if you're staying at a Hurghada resort and only want one or two dives at a time.

**Can beginners do a liveaboard trip?**

Most Hurghada liveaboard trips require at least an Open Water certification before booking, since the itinerary assumes independent diving skills. Non-certified travelers should start with Discover Scuba or a certification course first.


## One last thing

The lever most travelers miss when budgeting for 2026: water temperature swings across the year change what gear you actually need, and a thicker wetsuit rental in cooler months can nudge the total more than people expect. Ask upfront whether a 5mm suit is included or billed separately before you book — that one detail changes the real Hurghada diving cost more than picking between two similarly priced operators.
